# Content bank — Dash Light

**Generated by `node scripts/content-bank.js`. Do not edit by hand.**
Every line below is the app's own text. Editing it here would put safety
advice in a video that the app itself no longer gives.

48 lights, most dangerous first — which is also the order to shoot in, because the eight red ones are the videos somebody forwards.

Each block is the seven-second form: hook, what it means, one action, then the app.
Shoot the dashboard, not a screen recording. The app appears at the end, once.

**The safety rule holds in a caption as it does on a screen:** never say the car
is safe. The app says what the lamp does or does not require — it is one photo of
one lamp, and it cannot see smoke, hear a bearing, or feel the steering.

Carry the disclaimer in the caption of every video giving an instruction:
> Guidance from a photo, not a technical diagnosis. It does not replace a mechanic.

| **Body** 2–6s | Either the parking brake is still applied, the brake fluid is low, or the hydraulic system has a fault. | إمّا أن فرامل الانتظار مرفوعة، أو أن زيت الفرامل ناقص، أو أن هناك عطلاً في النظام الهيدروليكي. |
| **Action** 6–9s | Release the handbrake first; if the light stays on, stop as soon as it's safe and have the car towed, not driven. | أنزل فرامل الانتظار أولاً؛ فإن بقي المصباح مضاءً، فتوقّف بأمان واطلب شاحنة سحب بدلاً من قيادتها. |

| **Hook** 0–2s | This light is not an emergency. It is a deadline. | هذه اللمبة ليست حالة طارئة، لكنها موعد نهائي. |

| **Action** 6–9s | Keep speeds moderate and book a hybrid-trained workshop within a day or two. | خفّف السرعة وحافظ على اعتدالها، واحجز موعداً في مركز صيانة متخصص بالسيارات الهجينة خلال يوم أو يومين. |

| **Body** 2–6s | The security system isn't recognising the key's transponder, so the engine is blocked from starting or will cut out. | لا يتعرّف نظام منع التشغيل على شريحة المفتاح، فيمنع التشغيل أو يطفئ المحرك. |

| **Action** 6–9s | Don't switch off until you're somewhere you can get help; to start, hold the fob against the marked spot by the start button. | لا تطفئ المحرك حتى تصل إلى مكان تجد فيه مساعدة، وللتشغيل ضع المفتاح في الموضع المخصص بجوار زر التشغيل. |

### Oil Level Low · مستوى الزيت منخفض
`oil-level-low` — Engine Oil Level Low

> **Do not shoot this one yet.** The pictogram in the app is the wrong symbol (`symbol-specs.md`). A video teaching the wrong shape outlives the fix.

| | English | العربية |
|---|---|---|
| **Hook** 0–2s | This light is not an emergency. It is a deadline. | هذه اللمبة ليست حالة طارئة، لكنها موعد نهائي. |

| **Action** 6–9s | Check the dipstick cold on level ground and top up with the grade in the owner's manual. | افحص مقياس الزيت والسيارة باردة وعلى أرض مستوية، وأضف النوع نفسه المدوَّن في دليل المالك. |

---

## The three that are not in this bank

1. **The scan itself.** A screen recording of a photograph becoming a verdict is
   a product demo, and product demos are watched by people who already want the
   product. The dashboard is the shot.
2. **The model.** Nobody installs an app because of what runs inside it. They
   install it because they do not know whether they can keep driving.
3. **A discount.** Stating one in the app is a review finding, and stating one in
   a video is a promise the storefront may not keep.
